# dbt analytics engineering (dbt Labs)

Build and modify dbt models the right way: ref/source, tests and checking results with dbt show.

- Source: https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dbt-labs/dbt-agent-skills/main/skills/dbt/skills/using-dbt-for-analytics-engineering/SKILL.md
- Author: dbt Labs
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/dbt-analytics-engineering-dbt-labs-6706ced0

dbt Labs' core skill for any dbt work. It guides how to structure the DAG and models, insists on looking at the actual data before modeling, writes tests, validates output with dbt show, and keeps warehouse costs down. It lists common mistakes and includes reference guides and scripts. Requires the dbt CLI.

**Try asking:**
- "Build a dbt model for monthly active customers"
- "Add tests to our orders models"
- "This dbt model fails to compile, fix it"
